title: VIXEN worker worktree needs a discoverable box-queue entry point
body: The required command bash tools/with-test-lock.sh failed with exit 127 because this VIXEN worktree has no tools/with-test-lock.sh. I had to discover /home/liory/.local/bin/with-test-lock.sh and use it; that shim resolves to /home/liory/projects/undertow/tools/with-test-lock.sh. Provide a repository-local documented entry point or make the configured queue wrapper discoverable from VIXEN worker worktrees so queued GPU test runs do not depend on manual path discovery.
